description: Real-time updates on user's orders and positions - requires authentication

product_ids: string - optional array of product IDs to filter. If empty, receives all products.

notes: User channel sends initial OPEN orders in batches of 50. Watch for first message with < 50 orders to know when snapshot is complete. One connection per user - close and resubscribe to change product_ids.
use_case: Track order fills, cancellations, and position updates in real-time. Receive all order status changes.
authentication_note: JWT token required - obtain from your API authentication endpoint
initial_snapshot: First messages contain OPEN orders in batches of max 50. Example: 109 orders = 3 messages (50, 50, 9)
important: This is the primary channel for tracking order lifecycle in the trading bot
